name: Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat Airport

runway.v: three runways; the longest, 06L/24R, is 3,352 m long and 60 m wide

slots.v: in summer, general aviation slots (arrival and departure) are coordinated no more than 30 days ahead
slots.quote: During the summer season, general aviation slots (arrival + departure) will not be coordinated more than 30 days in advance.

max_aircraft.v: from June to September, aircraft of 15,000 kg MTOW or less cannot arrive between 07:00 and 11:30
max_aircraft.quote: they cannot operate arrivals within the time period 0700-1130

handling.v: the AIP lists AVIAVIP FBO, United Aviation FBO, ExecuJet Spain, General Aviation Service, Jetex Executive Aviation Barcelona, Skyvalet and Universal Aviation Spain as general aviation agents and FBO managers
handling.quote: General Aviation agents and General and Business Aviation terminal Managers (FBO):

noise.v: night is 23:00-07:00 local; at night runways 02 and 20 are not used for take-off and runway 06R not for landing (except for safety reasons or when no other runway is available); runways 24R/06L only for aircraft that request them and justify the need for the longer runway, with the justification sent within 7 days (ambulance, rescue and State flights exempt); reverse thrust above idle forbidden at night on 06L/24R and 02. A night runway configuration applies 23:00-07:00 local
noise.quote: The term night is applicable to the time period between 2300-0700 LT ... RWY 02 and 20 for take-off, and RWY 06R for landing shall not be used during night hours except for safety reasons
noise.also_quote: Night time configuration between 2300 and 0700 LT:

missing: curfew (AIP AD 2.21, AIRAC AMDT 09/26, restricts night runway use 23:00-07:00 LT but neither bans night movements nor states there is no curfew)
ppr (no PPR stated in the parts read; slot rules recorded instead)
notes: Night-time noise operating restrictions are in AD 2-LEBL item 21.1 sections 5 and 6, which the HTML page as read did not contain (the 15,000 kg 07:00-11:30 rule time basis not stated; excludes ambulance, emergency, State and some public service flights). The night runway configuration is not a curfew. Ramp-0 is for corporate and private aircraft only. No PPR wording found; non-regular GA operators must request arrival and associated departure slots, stay limited to 96 hours.
